title: Five killed in shooting at Krakow's main square, Polish police say
dek: A gunman fired from a car in the centre of one of Poland's best known cities. Motive is not known, and posts are already giving it different names.
what: On the afternoon of 7 November, a gunman fired from a vehicle near Krakow's Main Market Square. The BBC reports that Polish police say five people were killed and around a dozen injured. CTV News gives 12 injured. JPost gives at least 10 injured, including police officers.
JPost reports that the suspect wore military-style clothing and used a long, military-type firearm, and that police shot him and detained him. It says he was taken to a hospital.
JPost reports that Prime Minister Donald Tusk posted that police were investigating a shooting and that he was being informed by the Interior Ministry.

I could not find any statement from police or the government on who the man is or why he did it. Some posts call it a terror attack. One post says it happened near a protest against the EU and Tusk and blames Brussels. None of the reports I opened mentions a protest, and I could not confirm one. Figures are as of the afternoon of 7 November and may change.
why: A mass shooting in a historic city centre, where public shootings are rare, drew fast posting from news accounts before the facts were in. Early posts filled the gap on motive.
next: Statements from Polish police or prosecutors on the suspect and motive, and the final count of dead and injured.
